scope_gate.rule: The GA must optimize a direct objective and must not reconstruct hidden parameters, sources, or states from observations through a forward model.

criteria_1_2.c1_full_text: A lawful full text of the required publication version is available.
criteria_1_2.c2_dimension: The selected experimental cell has at least 11 genuine decision variables.

g3.name: runtime_ga_control_change
g3.rule: At least one mutation, crossover, selection/tournament, elitism, replacement, or operator-selection control actually changes within the published run.

g4.name: not_surrogate_only
g4.rule: Changing only a surrogate, fitness, or forward model does not qualify; the change must control a GA operator or GA policy.

g5.name: complete_adaptation_semantics
g5.rule: The adaptation rule and its initial/min/max values, update frequency, order, feedback trigger, and boundary behavior are executable without invention.

g6.name: complete_ga_pipeline
g6.rule: Objective, representation, constraints, initialization, selection, crossover, mutation, replacement/elitism, and termination are known. Explicitly absent operators must be justified.

g7.name: lawful_reproducible_inputs
g7.rule: Inputs are lawful and complete or the synthetic generator is fully defined; no required unavailable CFD/FEM, closed hardware experiment, or paid solver is allowed.

g8.name: literal_numeric_published_target
g8.rule: At least one literal numeric published result has an unambiguous protocol cell and can be checked without reading a fuzzy graph.

g9.name: stochastic_protocol_and_provenance
g9.rule: Run count, seed/RNG rule, independence unit, budget/stopping, aggregation/analysis, and provenance are sufficient for an honest comparison.

g10.name: cross_environment_feasibility
g10.rule: A clean-room MATLAB implementation is technically feasible; if author code is claimed as a reproduction artifact, a source-native run must also be possible.

derivation.hard_pass: direct_only, c1, c2, and every g3-g10 status are pass
derivation.conditional_noneligible: no immutable scope exclusion, but at least one gate is unresolved or externally adjudicable
derivation.hard_fail: at least one decisive gate failure under the frozen scope
derivation.score_rule: final_score is numeric only for hard_pass; otherwise it is null
derivation.reproduction_rule: eligibility and formula validation never imply PASS_FULL
